what: poem-scoped Chinese (zh) WRITTEN-PLANT single-graph inventory — the board-local zh WRITTEN plant channel for the 'song_youren' exhibition board ONLY. The task's target: the character 蕭 carries the 艸 (grass/plant, Kangxi radical 140) radical latently via the WRITTEN channel; its classical noun sense is 艾蒿 (artemisia / mugwort). This file records that written-channel evidence with citations. A zh character carries a latent-WRITTEN plant sense iff a citable single-graph source records a plant radical / plant headword sense for it.
tier: EXHIBITION — board 'song_youren' ONLY. NOT wired into trait_labelers / latent_written_labeler_53 / the live written plant inventory (hownet_plant_chars_54.json), NOT into the 8-board census / miner / heat-map. credential: CITATION-ALONE, deterministic single-graph lookup. Two independent written-channel sources per row: (1) Unicode Unihan kRSUnicode (the Kangxi radical/stroke field — the SAME Unihan data-file family the law reads for its variant fold, linegrain_law_60._fold_map / marking/tools/vectors/Unihan_Variants.txt, and the SAME radical field trait_labelers._load_radicals reads); (2) MOE 《重編國語辭典修訂本》 headword sense (the 部首字 radical field + the 釋義 gloss). No encoder, no model for THIS channel.
why_board_local: The LIVE zh written-plant inventory (caesitas_proto/results/hownet_plant_chars_54.json, the source read by latent_score_54.load_zh_carriers -> ZhWritten) is HowNet-sememe-based (a char charges iff a single-char HowNet DEF carries a deployed plant sememe {FlowerGrass|花草}/{plant|植物}/{tree|树}). HowNet is SIMPLIFIED-DOMINANT and MISSES 蕭: HowNet's entry for 蕭 (traditional) is the bare placeholder {character|文字:belong={China|中国}} (exactly the 蘭/楓 simplified-dominance case the plant inventory itself documents), and for 萧 (simplified) is {desolate|荒}/{surname|姓} — NO plant sememe on either. So 蕭 is NOT in hownet_plant_chars_54.json (checked: 蕭 and 萧 both absent from the 259 charged_chars_any_position). The print-charged plant of 蕭 (radical 艸, sense 艾蒿) is therefore invisible to the LIVE WRITTEN channel. This artifact supplies it FOR THIS BOARD ONLY, cited, never touching the shared labeler or the census.
status_declared: SETTLED CITATION (not PROPOSED). Unlike the tao_yinjiu illumination board (which rested on a PROPOSED MOE illum artifact), this board's written-plant evidence rests on (1) the Unicode Unihan kRSUnicode field — a stable, adopted data source already used by the live instruments — and (2) MOE headword senses that are lexicographic facts. No ratification is pending for the radical fact itself. The board-local status is about SCOPE (this inventory is not wired into the shared plant instrument), not about the reliability of the citation.
CRITICAL_HONESTY_NOTE: THE WORD TIER ALSO CHARGES 蕭 AS PLANT — so on this board the zh plant is STATED (word), NOT latent (written). The live DESCRIPTIVE plant labeler trait_labelers.zh_plant() is ITSELF radical-attestation-based: a char charges iff it is attested in 《爾雅》釋草/釋木 (Erya, Wikisource PD) AND carries a Kangxi plant radical (Unihan kRSUnicode, PLANT_RADICALS includes 140 艸). 蕭 satisfies BOTH — it is a 釋草 (herb-chapter) headword (the artemisia sense) and radical 140 — so trait_labelers.zh_plant() charges it and the zh WORD plant boolean fires True on L8 with receipt ['蕭']. (Note 萧, the simplified form, is NOT in the traditional Erya text and does NOT fire.) Per linegrain_law_60.line_state precedence (word STATED > written latent > referent), the zh side resolves to STATED/active, NOT latent. Consequence: the L8 crossing lands (active, absent) = DEFORMATION, NOT the (latent, absent) = LATENT-UNREALIZED the task expected. The task's premise — that 蕭's plant is carried ONLY latently via the WRITTEN channel — is falsified by the live instrument: the SAME radical evidence this file cites is already promoted to the WORD tier by the radical-aware descriptive labeler. Reported honestly (task rule: 'REPORT what IS'; do NOT fake the verdict).

rows.moe_sense_noun_1: 一種香草。即艾蒿。《說文解字．艸部》：「蕭，艾蒿也。」《詩經．王風．采葛》：「彼采蕭兮，一日不見，如三秋兮。」
rows.moe_cite: MOE 《重編國語辭典修訂本》 s.v. 蕭 (字詞號 07008), 部首字=艸, 釋義 [名]1: 一種香草，即艾蒿 (a kind of aromatic herb, i.e. artemisia / mugwort), citing 《說文解字．艸部》「蕭，艾蒿也」 (Shuowen Jiezi, artemisia in the 艸-radical section) and 《詩經．王風．采葛》「彼采蕭兮」 (Shijing: 'there he gathers artemisia'). The MOE 部首字 (radical) field agrees with Unihan: 艸.
rows.shuowen_cite: 《說文解字．艸部》：「蕭，艾蒿也。」 — Shuowen Jiezi (Xu Shen, c. 100 CE), the foundational Chinese etymological dictionary, classes 蕭 under the 艸 (grass/plant) radical section and glosses it 艾蒿 (artemisia). This is the WRITTEN-channel plant charge: the graph's radical + its founding etymological gloss.
rows.note: 蕭 is the sole plant-radical character in the poem's 8 lines. Its plant sense is the artemisia (艾蒿 / 香草) noun sense, carried by the 艸 radical and the Shuowen gloss. THE WORD 蕭蕭 (reduplicated) is read as ONOMATOPOEIA — the rustling of wind / the whinnying of horses (MOE 釋義 [形]1 寂寥冷清 '蕭瑟'/'蕭條' is the desolate-sound adjective sense; here 蕭蕭 modifies 班馬鳴, the horses' neighing). So the SOUND is what the reduplicated word realizes; the plant is the graph's latent botanical sense. BUT SEE CRITICAL_HONESTY_NOTE: the live descriptive plant labeler (Erya 釋草 ∧ radical 140) promotes this very plant charge to the WORD tier, so on this board the zh plant is STATED, not latent.
